_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Data_mail.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

Beat_PK.chinese: 恭喜你！！！^^你通关了“草原之王的冒险之旅”并被我们选为特别奖励获得者！^你赢得了专属于你自己的草原之王的冒险之旅游戏系统！^现在你可以在家享受“草原之王的冒险之旅”带来的乐趣！^^这是你的奖赏！^——草原之王的冒险之旅开发团队 %item id (BC)141 %%[#]草原之王的冒险之旅的祝贺
Beat_PK.english: Congratulations!!! You cleared "The Prairie King's Adventure Journey" and were selected by us as a special reward winner! You've won a Prairie King's Adventure Journey game system belonging exclusively to you! Now you can enjoy the fun that "The Prairie King's Adventure Journey" brings at home! This is your reward! —The Prairie King's Adventure Journey development team [#] The Prairie King's Adventure Journey's congratulations

Bouquet.chinese: @：^最近你似乎和镇上的某个人走得很近。如果你想示爱的话，就得送上一束漂亮的鲜花。我这儿卖的花，价钱极其公道！如果你某一天想组建一个家庭，这是第一步！^——皮埃尔[#]关于鲜花
Bouquet.english: @: Lately you seem to be getting very close to someone in town. If you want to show love, you must give a bunch of pretty flowers. The flowers I sell here are priced extremely fairly! If one day you want to start a family, this is the first step! - Pierre [About flowers]

CF_Fish.chinese: 亲爱的@：^你的钓鱼技术比我家老头子还厉害啊！我很震撼。^这个星之果实从老威利传到小威利，再传到……哇。反正有快一千年的历史了。^我膝下无子……干脆把他传给你吧。^^——威利 ^%item id (O)434 1 %%[#]威利的传家宝
CF_Fish.english: Dear @: Your fishing skill is even more impressive than my family's old man! I'm stunned. This stardrop was passed from old Willy to little Willy, then passed to... wow. Anyway it has almost a thousand years of history. I have no children... might as well pass it to you. - Willy [Willy's family heirloom]

segments.gloss: have no children (lit. no son at the knee)

Caroline.chinese: 亲爱的@：^这是我在小院里种的青菜。或许你那儿的蔬菜已经多到连你都不知该怎么处理了，但没关系。 ^—卡洛琳%item id (O)190 1 (O)192 1 (O)24 1 %%[#]来自卡洛琳的礼物
Caroline.english: Dear @: These are greens I grew in my little yard. Perhaps the vegetables at your place are already so many that even you don't know how to deal with them, but it doesn't matter. - Caroline [A gift from Caroline]

CarolineCooking.chinese: 亲爱的@：^没有什么能比用自己种的菜做饭更让人满足的了！我随信附上了一份食谱。照顾好自己。 ^—卡洛琳%item cookingRecipe %%[#]卡洛琳的食谱
CarolineCooking.english: Dear @: Nothing can make one more satisfied than cooking with vegetables you grew yourself! I've enclosed a recipe with this letter. Take good care of yourself. —Caroline [#] Caroline's recipe

CarolineTea.chinese: 亲爱的@：^^感谢你昨天来我的日光房做客。我经常独自喝茶，但和你一起享用真的很愉快！^^我随信附上了自己种植茶叶的前期准备和具体步骤。不要有压力，不过如果你最后种植成功了，请一定要给我带一杯你的茶！^^——卡洛琳%item craftingRecipe Tea_Sapling %%[#]卡洛琳的种茶笔记
CarolineTea.english: Dear @: Thanks for coming as a guest to my sunroom yesterday. I often drink tea alone, but enjoying it with you was really pleasant! I've enclosed the preparation and specific steps for growing tea leaves yourself. No pressure, but if you do succeed in growing it in the end, please be sure to bring me a cup of your tea! —Caroline [#] Caroline's tea-growing notes

Clint.chinese: 呃，你好……^抱歉，我不怎么会写信。我一不小心做多了金属棒，或许你能用得上。^—铁匠克林特 %item id (O)334 1 (O)335 1 (O)336 1 %%[#]来自克林特的礼物
Clint.english: Uh, hello... Sorry, I'm not very good at writing letters. I accidentally made too many metal bars; perhaps you can make use of them. —Clint the blacksmith [#] A gift from Clint

ClintCooking.chinese: 嗯，我倒是知道两三种配方。^告诉你一种的话……或许能帮你多开采些矿石也说不定。^保重。 ^——克林特%item cookingRecipe %%[#]克林特的配方
ClintCooking.english: Um, I do actually know two or three recipes. If I tell you one... maybe it can help you mine a bit more ore, who knows. Take care. —Clint [#] Clint's recipe

ClintReward.chinese: 呃，你好……^谢谢你帮我清掉了那些怪物。^^我一点也不害怕的！……但是维护矿井的安全是有必要的，对大家都好……是不是？^^给你这个设计图。（有了这个也别忘了光顾我的铺子啊……）^^——铁匠克林特%item craftingRecipe Geode_Crusher %%[#]克林特的感谢
ClintReward.english: Uh, hello... Thank you for helping me clear out those monsters. I wasn't scared at all! ...But keeping the mine safe is necessary, it's good for everyone... right? Here's this blueprint for you. (Having this, don't forget to still visit my shop...) —Clint the blacksmith [#] Clint's thanks

ClintReward2.chinese: 呃，你好……^谢谢你帮我清掉了更多怪物。^^也许下次我就能自己收拾它们了……如果我有空！^^给你这个，是我在里屋找到的……^^——铁匠克林特%item id (O)286 10 (O)287 5 (O)231 3 %%[#]克林特的再次感谢
ClintReward2.english: Uh, hello... Thank you for helping me clear out more monsters. Maybe next time I can deal with them myself... if I have time! Here's this for you; I found it in the back room... —Clint the blacksmith [#] Clint's thanks again

Demetrius.chinese: 亲爱的@：^我前几天做了次实地考察，然后发现了这个标本。^我希望你和我一样对它感兴趣。 ^——德米特里厄斯 %item id (O)392 1 (O)394 1 (O)132 1 (O)66 1 %%[#]来自德米特里厄斯的礼物
Demetrius.english: Dear @: A few days ago I did a field study, and then found this specimen. I hope you're as interested in it as I am. —Demetrius [#] A gift from Demetrius

DemetriusCooking.english: Demetrius. I want to thank you for your support of my work. This is a cooking recipe I like. —Demetrius [#] Demetrius's recipe

DesertFestival.chinese: 亲爱的@：^^明天开始会在卡利科沙漠庆祝节日，为期 3 天。^^多亏巴士修好了，我们得以延续这个历史悠久的传统，大家都十分高兴。^^到时候会有趣味游戏、免费食物、丰厚奖品，活动多多！^^另外，每天会有两位镇上的居民负责开小商店，记得来逛逛，看看有什么可以买的。^^期待在节日上见到你！^——刘易斯[#]沙漠节提醒
DesertFestival.english: Dear @: Starting tomorrow a festival will be celebrated in the Calico Desert, lasting 3 days. Thanks to the bus being repaired, we're able to continue this long-standing tradition, and everyone is very happy. When the time comes there'll be fun games, free food, generous prizes, lots of activities! Also, every day two town residents will be in charge of running a little shop; remember to come stroll around and see what you can buy. Looking forward to seeing you at the festival! —Lewis [#] Desert festival reminder

Duck.chinese: 亲爱的@：^你已经证明了自己养鸡的实力，所以我的店里要开始卖鸭子了！^——玛妮[#]鸭子开始售卖！
Duck.english: Dear @: You've proven your ability to raise chickens, so my shop is going to start selling ducks! —Marnie [#] Ducks start selling!

Emily.chinese: 嗨！^你还好吗？希望你能喜欢我给你送去的礼物……那么，再见！^——艾米丽 %item id (O)397 1 (O)428 1 (O)440 1 %%[#]来自艾米丽的礼物
Emily.english: Hi! Are you doing okay? I hope you like the gift I sent you... well then, goodbye! —Emily [#] A gift from Emily

EmilyCamping.chinese: @：^我们去野营吧！^^晚上 10 点后我们在秘密森林见。^^爱你，艾米丽[#]艾米丽的邀请
EmilyCamping.english: @: Let's go camping! After 10 pm let's meet in the secret forest. Love you, Emily [#] Emily's invitation

EmilyClothingTherapy.chinese: @，^我有了一个疯狂的新想法，我想你了解……所谓的“服装疗法”。^^请在今天去镇长的家里，了解它是关于什么的。^^爱你，艾米丽[#]艾米丽的想法
EmilyClothingTherapy.english: @, I've had a crazy new idea; I want you to understand... the so-called "clothing therapy". Please go to the mayor's house today to learn what it's about. Love you, Emily [#] Emily's idea

EmilyCooking.chinese: @！^把这封信翻过来，上面写有一种超级健康的饭菜做法！^那会让你感觉精力充沛。那一会见咯！ ^——艾米丽%item cookingRecipe %%[#]艾米丽的健康食谱
EmilyCooking.english: @! Turn this letter over; on it is written how to make a super healthy meal! That will make you feel full of energy. See you in a bit then! —Emily [#] Emily's healthy recipe

EmilyDoneCamping.chinese: 昨晚，谢谢你赴约……我度过了一段美好的时光。^我真的很感激熊的出现！^^再见^^爱你，艾米丽[#]艾米丽的笔记
EmilyDoneCamping.english: Last night, thank you for keeping our date... I had a wonderful time. I'm really grateful the bear showed up! Goodbye. Love you, Emily [#] Emily's note

Evelyn.chinese: 你好，亲爱的，希望你的农场一切都好。^我在厨房里做了点儿东西，给你寄去……但愿别在信里压碎了。 ^——艾芙琳 %item id (O)216 1 (O)220 1 (O)223 1 %%[#]来自艾芙琳的礼物
Evelyn.english: Hello, dear, I hope everything on your farm is well. I made a little something in the kitchen and am mailing it to you... I hope it doesn't get crushed in the letter. —Evelyn [#] A gift from Evelyn

EvelynCooking.chinese: 亲爱的@：^我一般不把我的配方告诉别人……但是你对我和乔治都太好了，所以我把这份配方送给你。 ^——艾芙琳%item cookingRecipe %%[#]艾芙琳的配方
EvelynCooking.english: Dear @: I usually don't tell others my recipes... but you've been so good to me and George, so I'm giving this recipe to you. —Evelyn [#] Evelyn's recipe

FizzIntro.chinese: 你好。^^我听说你在挑战一个很特殊的目标。^^我这里有一个能“完美”帮到你的解决方案。^^我在姜岛上有水的洞穴里等你。^^——菲兹^Joja 特别服务部门[#]菲兹的信
FizzIntro.english: Hello. I heard you're taking on a very special goal. I have a solution here that can "perfectly" help you. I'm waiting for you in the cave with water on Ginger Island. —Fizz, Joja Special Services Department [#] Fizz's letter

George.chinese: 我找到了一些优质石材。^也许你能用它建点儿什么。 ^——乔治 %item id (O)390 35 %%[#]来自乔治的礼物
George.english: I found some high-quality stone. Maybe you can build something with it. - George [A gift from George]

GeorgeCooking.chinese: 这份配方我留着也没用，索性给你试试吧。小心别把它烧了。 ^——乔治%item cookingRecipe %%[#]乔治的食谱
GeorgeCooking.english: This recipe is no use to me keeping it, so I might as well give it to you to try. Be careful not to burn it. - George [George's recipe]

Goats.chinese: 亲爱的@：^现在我的动物商店里有山羊出售！到目前为止你做得很好！^——玛妮[#]山羊开始售卖！
Goats.english: Dear @: Now there are goats for sale in my animal shop! So far you've done very well! - Marnie [Goats go on sale!]

GreenRainGus.chinese: 我看了昨晚的天气预报。^^不知道会发生什么事，我明天会全天开放酒吧，大家可以来避难。^^——格斯[#]酒吧避难所
GreenRainGus.english: I watched last night's weather forecast. I don't know what will happen; tomorrow I'll open the saloon all day, everyone can come take shelter. - Gus [Saloon shelter]

Gus.chinese: @！^今天早上我在酒吧里给你做了些好吃的。来吃吧！^—你的朋友，格斯%item id (O)224 1 (O)213 1 (O)211 1 (O)207 1 (O)200 1 (O)195 1 (O)198 1 %%[#]来自格斯的礼物
Gus.english: @! This morning I made you some tasty things at the saloon. Come eat! - Your friend, Gus [A gift from Gus]

GusCooking.chinese: 亲爱的 @：^这是我酒吧的食谱。我只和好朋友分享这个！^——格斯%item cookingRecipe %%[#]格斯的配方
GusCooking.english: Dear @: This is my saloon's recipe. I only share this with good friends! - Gus [Gus's recipe]

Jodi.chinese: 亲爱的@：^我给花园订购了太多肥料了！！我想你应该用得上。请多多保重！^——乔迪 %item id (O)368 5 (O)369 5 (O)370 5 %%[#]来自乔迪的礼物
Jodi.english: Dear @: I ordered too much fertilizer for the garden!! I think you should be able to use it. Please take good care! - Jodi [A gift from Jodi]

JodiCooking.chinese: @：^这份食谱曾帮我在烹饪比赛里赢得第一名！希望你喜欢。就算是朋友的谢礼吧！^——乔迪%item cookingRecipe %%[#]乔迪的配方
JodiCooking.english: @: This recipe once helped me win first place in a cooking contest! Hope you like it. Just count it as a friend's thank-you gift! - Jodi [Jodi's recipe]

JunimoKart.chinese: 恭喜你！！！^^你通关了，你是芬吉尔共和国第一个通过的人！^你的奖励：一台家庭版的祝尼魔赛车！^^好好享受游戏！^——祝尼魔赛车开发团队 %item id (BC)159 %%[#]祝尼魔赛车通关！
JunimoKart.english: Congratulations!!! You beat the game; you're the first person in the Republic of Fingiel to clear it! Your reward: a home edition of Junimo Kart! Enjoy the game! - Junimo Kart development team [Junimo Kart cleared!]

Kent.chinese: 你好，@。^这东西一直放在工具房里积灰。我想你也许用得上它。 ^——肯特%item id (O)286 1 (O)287 1 (O)288 1 (O)787 1 %%[#]来自肯特的礼物
Kent.english: Hello, @. This thing has been sitting in the tool shed gathering dust. I think maybe you can use it. - Kent [A gift from Kent]

KentCooking.chinese: 我是在国外发现的这份配方。尽情品尝吧。^我想要对你的好客说声谢谢。 ^^——肯特%item cookingRecipe %%[#]肯特的配方
KentCooking.english: I found this recipe abroad. Enjoy it to your heart's content. I want to say thanks to you for your hospitality. - Kent [Kent's recipe]

KrobusCrafting.chinese: @，我不知道人类的信是怎么写的，所以我请法师帮我写了这封信。^^希望你一切都好。^^我想给你看看这个……是我的同族人制作一样东西的笔记……^^——科罗布斯%item craftingRecipe Dark_Sign %%[#]来自科罗布斯的信
KrobusCrafting.english: @, I don't know how human letters are written, so I asked the wizard to help me write this letter. I hope all is well with you. I want to show you this... it's notes on something made by my kin... - Krobus [A letter from Krobus]

LeoCooking.chinese: @：^这是我家乡的一种食物，大伙都很爱吃，希望你也喜欢。^^——雷欧^^备注：信是威利帮我写的。%item cookingRecipe %%[#]雷欧的食谱
LeoCooking.english: @: This is a food from my hometown, everyone loves to eat it, hope you like it too. - Leo. P.S.: Willy helped me write the letter. [Leo's recipe]

Lewis.chinese: @：^很高兴你能加入我们的社区！我随信给你寄了一张来自星露谷农业基金的 500 金支票，以资助你继续努力工作。^或许你能用它买些种子。^此致敬礼，刘易斯先生%item money 500 501 %%[#]来自刘易斯的礼物
Lewis.english: @: I'm very happy you could join our community! With this letter I've sent you a 500g check from the Stardew Valley Agricultural Fund, to fund your continued hard work. Perhaps you can use it to buy some seeds. Sincerely, Mayor Lewis [A gift from Lewis]

LewisCooking.chinese: @：^要注意健康饮食，才能有足够的体力工作！随信附上一份我最爱的配方。记着要用熟的西红柿。^——刘易斯%item cookingRecipe %%[#]刘易斯的配方
LewisCooking.english: @: You need to pay attention to eating healthily, only then will you have enough stamina to work! Enclosed with this letter is one of my favorite recipes. Remember to use ripe tomatoes. - Lewis [Lewis's recipe]

Linus.chinese: 你好，朋友。^最近我在山湖那里的收获不错。我想和你分享这份好运。 ^——莱纳斯 %item id (O)136 1 (O)143 1 (O)202 1 (O)227 1 (O)228 1 %%[#]一份来自莱纳斯的礼物
Linus.english: Hello, friend. Lately my harvest at the mountain lake has been good. I want to share this good luck with you. - Linus [A gift from Linus]

LinusCooking.chinese: @：^你最近过的怎么样？我随信附上了我最爱的鱼料理做法。 ^——莱纳斯%item cookingRecipe %%[#]莱纳斯的食谱
LinusCooking.english: @: How have you been lately? With this letter I've enclosed how to make my favorite fish dish. - Linus [Linus's recipe]

MSB_Lewis.chinese: @：^感谢你帮我完成特别订单。你所付出的努力极大地提升了鹈鹕镇的形象。^给你一个“迷你出货箱”表达我对你的感谢。^把它放在哪里都行，轮到我巡视的时候一定会处理好的。^^——刘易斯%item id (BC)248 %%[#]刘易斯的感谢
MSB_Lewis.english: @: Thanks for helping me complete special orders. The effort you put in has greatly boosted Pelican Town's image. Here's a "Mini-Shipping Bin" to express my thanks to you. Put it anywhere, when it's my turn to patrol I'll surely take care of it. - Lewis [Lewis's thanks]

MSB_Pierre.chinese: 亲爱的@：^^似乎人们对我的“皮埃尔优选”不感兴趣，有点失望……^^不说了。这是我以前的“迷你出货箱”，给你。^下次你拿到配得上“皮埃尔优选”名号的产品的时候，考虑一下把它们卖到我这来？^^——皮埃尔%item id (BC)248 %%[#]皮埃尔优选
MSB_Pierre.english: Dear @: It seems people aren't interested in my "Pierre's Prime", a bit disappointing... Enough said. This is my old "Mini-Shipping Bin", for you. Next time you get products worthy of the "Pierre's Prime" name, consider selling them over to me? - Pierre [Pierre's Prime]

MarlonRecovery.chinese: @：^你丢失的物品找到了。^^下次细心点！^   ——马龙%item itemRecovery %%[#]马龙找到了你的东西
MarlonRecovery.english: @: Your lost items have been found. Be more careful next time! - Marlon [Marlon found your stuff]

Marnie.chinese: 亲爱的@：^你是个好邻居，所以我想送些动物饲料给你，或许能帮得上你的忙。继续努力吧！^——玛妮 %item id (O)178 30 %%[#]来自玛妮的礼物
Marnie.english: Dear @: You're a good neighbor, so I want to give you some animal feed, maybe it can help you out. Keep working hard! - Marnie [A gift from Marnie]

MarnieCooking.chinese: 亲爱的邻居，^在照料动物之余，我喜欢在厨房里做些新尝试。既然我们成为了朋友，我想和你分享一些我的配方。^希望你能喜欢！^——玛妮%item cookingRecipe %%[#]玛妮的配方
MarnieCooking.english: Dear neighbor, besides looking after the animals, I like to try new things in the kitchen. Now that we've become friends, I want to share some of my recipes with you. Hope you like them! - Marnie [Marnie's recipe]

MarniePetAdoption.chinese: 亲爱的@：^^据我了解，你把家里的宠物照顾得非常好！我真的很惊喜！^^可是还是有很多可爱的动物需要一个家……我会在店里提供宠物领养，你感兴趣的话可以来看看。^^需要注意，办理饲养证需要一定费用，并且每只宠物都需要专属的宠物碗区域，否则它们会不高兴。宠物碗可以付费请罗宾安装。^^回头见！^——玛妮[#]关于宠物领养的信
MarniePetAdoption.english: Dear @: As far as I know, you've looked after the pet at home very well! I'm really pleasantly surprised! But there are still many cute animals that need a home... I'll offer pet adoption at the shop; if you're interested you can come take a look. elliottLetter6.english: Dear @: This is my last letter before coming home. My journey has been very pleasant... though nothing very exciting. Meeting people who like my books makes me very happy, but I still long to go home. I miss our cozy little house, the satisfying farm work, a home-cooked meal, and of course what I miss most is lying comfortably with you on the flannel sheets. Hoping to see you soon! Loving you, Elliott. My Husband's Letter 6

elliottReading.chinese: @：^我有个天大的好消息……我写完我的小说了！我下午会在图书馆前举行一个公开的阅读会。你一定要来！^——艾利欧特[#]艾利欧特的阅读会
elliottReading.english: @: I have some tremendous good news... I've finished writing my novel! This afternoon I'll hold a public reading in front of the library. You must come! Elliott. Elliott's Reading

emilyStones.chinese: @：^^你好。再次感谢你送给我的宝石，它们品质很好。^我的能量调息用这些宝石正正好好！^我想用这份特别的礼物表示我的感谢。希望你能用它做出更多好东西！^^——艾米丽%item id (BC)247 %%[#]艾米丽的宝石
emilyStones.english: @: Hello. Thanks again for the gems you gave me; their quality is very good. They're just perfect for my energy breathing practice! I want to express my thanks with this special gift. I hope you can make more good things with it! Emily. Emily's Gems

fall_15.chinese: 亲爱的@：^我想你一定知道明天就是星露谷展览会了吧。^记得带上九件物品来参加农庄展览。^注意，博览会会在明天上午 9 点在镇上广场举行。期待你的参与！^——镇长刘易斯[#]星露谷展会提醒
fall_15.english: Dear @: I think you surely know that tomorrow is the Stardew Valley Fair. Remember to bring nine items to take part in the farm display. Note, the fair will be held tomorrow at 9 a.m. in the town square. Looking forward to your participation! Mayor Lewis. Stardew Valley Fair Reminder

fall_19_1.chinese: @：^我想买个南瓜。我和女儿想在万灵节刻一个南瓜灯。 ^—卡洛琳%item quest 108 %%[#]卡洛琳的请求
fall_19_1.english: @: I want to buy a pumpkin. My daughter and I want to carve a jack-o'-lantern for Spirit's Eve. Caroline. Caroline's Request

fall_19_2.chinese: 通知^有谁有电池吗？我电视遥控器没电了，我实在懒得从椅子上下来去换台了。^——潘姆%item quest 122 %%[#]潘姆需要帮助
fall_19_2.english: Notice: Does anyone have batteries? My TV remote is out of power, and I really can't be bothered to get down from the chair to change the channel. Pam. Pam Needs Help

fall_26.chinese: 亲爱的@：^不知道你有没有注意到寒气，冬天可能要来了……^不然就是黑暗的游魂，呼啸着和我们一起庆祝今天的节日……万灵节！^晚上 10 点来镇里和我们一起庆祝吧。^——镇长刘易斯[#]万灵节通知
fall_26.english: Dear @: I wonder if you've noticed the chill; winter may be coming... Or else it's the dark wandering spirits, howling and celebrating today's festival with us... Spirit's Eve! Come to town at 10 p.m. and celebrate with us. Mayor Lewis. Spirit's Eve Notice

fall_3_1.chinese: 亲爱的@：^我想给我的奶牛们搞些好吃的。这些奶牛棒极了，就是有点饿，你能帮我搞到一把苋菜么。它们很爱苋菜。^麻烦你了，亲爱的。^——玛妮 %item quest 106 %%[#]玛妮的请求
fall_3_1.english: Dear @: I want to get some tasty things for my cows. These cows are great, just a bit hungry; can you help me get a bunch of amaranth? They love amaranth. Sorry to trouble you, dear. Marnie. Marnie's Request

fall_6_2.chinese: 征集：我需要一只新鲜的龙虾来制作美妙的浓汤。^征集人：星果酒吧的老板格斯^奖励：800 金 %item quest 121 %%[#]格斯需要龙虾
fall_6_2.english: Wanted: I need a fresh lobster to make a wonderful bisque. Requested by: Gus, owner of the Stardrop Saloon. Reward: 800 gold. Gus Needs a Lobster

fall_8_1.chinese: 你好，^又到了黑莓成熟的季节。外面的草丛里都是黑莓，我想摘点回去，但是我找不到我的篮子了。你可以帮我吗？^——莱纳斯%item quest 107 %%[#]莱纳斯弄丢了篮子
fall_8_1.english: Hello, it's blackberry-ripening season again. The bushes outside are full of blackberries, and I want to pick some to take back, but I can't find my basket. Can you help me? Linus. Linus Lost His Basket

fall_9.chinese: 亲爱的@：^我们将在一周后的今天举办星露谷展览会！^这项年度盛事会吸引全国各地的人们来到我们这个平和的小镇！^如果你想参加的话，你可以进行农庄展览。你只需要带上最能展示你才华的九份展览品。将对你的展品质量和品种进行评价！^展览会会在上午 9 点开始，别错过哦！^——镇长刘易斯[#]星露谷展会通知
fall_9.english: Dear @: One week from today we will hold the Stardew Valley Fair! This annual grand event will attract people from all over the country to our peaceful little town! If you want to take part, you can do a farm display. You just need to bring nine exhibits that best show your talent. Your exhibits' quality and variety will be evaluated! The fair starts at 9 a.m., don't miss it! Mayor Lewis. Stardew Valley Fair Notice

fertilizers.chinese: 亲爱的邻居，^希望你已经安顿好自己的新家了。我写信是想告诉你皮埃尔，的杂货店进了一批肥料！要不要去杂货店那里看看有什么要买的呢？ ^——皮埃尔 [#]皮埃尔的肥料
fertilizers.english: Dear neighbor, I hope you've already settled into your new home. I'm writing to tell you that Pierre's general store has got in a batch of fertilizer! Why not go to the general store and see what there is to buy? Pierre. Pierre's Fertilizer

fertilizers2.chinese: 亲爱的@：^现在店里进了一批高品质的化肥和新的谷物种子！欢迎光临！ ^——皮埃尔[#]皮埃尔的高品质肥料
fertilizers2.english: Dear @: The shop now has in a batch of high-quality fertilizer and new grain seeds! Welcome! Pierre. Pierre's High-Quality Fertilizer

fishing2.chinese: 我进了一些新货品！^豪华钓竿，你可以在上面放置饵料！^你可以使用饵料让鱼更快地上钩！欢迎前来购买！^——威利[#]威利的新货品
fishing2.english: I've got in some new goods! A deluxe fishing rod, you can put bait on it! You can use bait to make fish take the hook faster! Welcome to come and buy! Willy. Willy's New Goods

fishing6.chinese: 快来看一看瞧一瞧，新品鱼竿上市咯。^货真价实，你还可以装备不同的钓具！^欢迎前来选购！^——威利[#]威利的新货品 #2
fishing6.english: Come quick, take a look, have a look, new fishing rods are on the market. Genuine goods at fair prices, and you can also equip different tackle! Welcome to come and shop! Willy. Willy's New Goods #2

foundLostTools.chinese: 亲爱的@：^昨晚有人找到你的工具，放进失物招领箱了。^^到镇长办公室来拿吧。^^——镇长刘易斯[#]丢失的工具
foundLostTools.english: Dear @: Last night someone found your tools and put them in the lost-and-found box. Come to the mayor's office to get them. Mayor Lewis. Lost Tools

georgeGifts.chinese: 亲爱的@：^^谢谢你送来的韭葱，看起来新鲜而且美味。乔治会喜欢的。^^今天我要用 12 份包装好的小礼物给他一个惊喜！（多亏有你帮忙！）你可以过来看看！^^——艾芙琳^^附：请收下这份礼物，你会喜欢的！%item id (BC)246 %%[#]艾芙琳的感谢信
georgeGifts.english: Dear @: Thank you for the leeks you sent; they look fresh and delicious. George will like them. Today I'm going to surprise him with 12 small wrapped gifts! (Thanks to your help!) You can come over and take a look! Evelyn. P.S.: Please accept this gift, you'll like it! Evelyn's Thank-You Letter

guildQuest.chinese: 我发现你一直在探索那个旧矿井。我只能说，你生来就是个探险者。^只要击杀 10 只史莱姆， 你就能在我的探险家公会里拥有一席之地。^小心点。——马龙 %item quest 15 true %%[#]史莱姆击杀任务
guildQuest.english: I've noticed you've been exploring that old mine. All I can say is, you were born an adventurer. Just kill 10 slimes and you'll have a place in my Adventurer's Guild. Be careful. Marlon. Slime Slaying Quest

guntherBones.chinese: @：^^你好。谢谢你提供的骨头。它们正等着我去研究！你想想，每一块骨头都曾属于一个活着的远古生命，多么迷人。^^这是给你的感谢礼物，请收下这份独特的工艺配方！^^——冈瑟%item craftingRecipe Bone_Mill %%[#]冈瑟的便条
guntherBones.english: @: Hello. Thank you for the bones you provided. They're waiting for me to study them! Just think, every single bone once belonged to a living ancient life form, how fascinating. This is a thank-you gift for you, please accept this unique crafting recipe! Gunther. Gunther's Note

gusGiantOmelet.chinese: @：^^你好。感谢你给的蛋。^这蛋黄看起来质量很棒……我觉得这会是我做过的最好的煎蛋卷！^^请收下这份礼物。^^——格斯%item id (BC)216 %%[#]格斯的著名煎蛋卷
gusGiantOmelet.english: @: Hello. Thanks for the eggs you gave. These yolks look great quality... I think this will be the best omelet I've ever made! Please accept this gift. Gus. Gus's Famous Omelet

haleyGarden.chinese: @：^我觉得给你写封短信会很有趣。^昨天我和奶牛玩儿得很尽兴……我开始理解你为什么会选择田园生活了！希望很快就能见到你。 ^——海莉[#]海莉的短信
haleyGarden.english: @: I thought it'd be fun to write you a short letter. Yesterday I had a great time playing with the cows... I'm starting to understand why you chose country life! Hope to see you soon. Haley. Haley's Note

harveyBalloon.chinese: @：^我想给你一个惊喜。在铁轨旁等我。 ^——哈维[#]哈维的惊喜
harveyBalloon.english: @: I want to give you a surprise. Wait for me by the railroad tracks. Harvey. Harvey's Surprise

hatter.chinese: 嗨。^^窝卖帽子。听懂了吗，波克？^^波克，到破房兹这里来。带点金闭。^^——帽子老鼠[#]嗨哟，波克
hatter.english: Hi. Me sell hats. Got it, Poke? Poke, come here to the broken house. Bring some coins. Hat Mouse. Hiyo, Poke

incubator.chinese: 亲爱的@：^^感谢你选择购买鸡舍升级服务！我不仅让你的鸡舍容量翻了一番，我还帮你安装了孵化器。^你只要把鸡蛋放入孵化器即可。只要你的鸡舍还有位置，过不了几天鸡蛋就会孵化啦。^^很感谢您的光临。^——罗宾[#]关于孵化器
incubator.english: Dear @: Thank you for choosing to buy the coop upgrade service! I not only doubled your coop's capacity, I also installed an incubator for you. You just put eggs into the incubator. As long as your coop still has space, the eggs will hatch within a few days. Thank you very much for your patronage. Robin. About the Incubator

joshMessage.chinese: @：^天黑后到酒馆见我。 ^——亚历克斯[#]亚历克斯的邀请
joshMessage.english: @: Meet me at the saloon after dark. Alex. Alex's Invitation

landslideDone.chinese: 尊敬的 Joja 超市的顾客：^我们的团队成员已经清理了山体滑坡现场，这次山体滑坡是受到我们公司钻井活动的影响。我们必须声明我们的钻井活动是完全合法的（依据 Joja 公司第 L61091 修正案）而保护当地环境一直都是我们的优先考量！^^我们对这次的意外带来的不便深感歉意。^我们由衷地对顾客的支持和赞助表示感谢！^^——莫里斯^Joja 顾客满意部门代表[#]Joja 清理滑坡
landslideDone.english: Respected Joja supermarket customer: Our team members have cleared the landslide site; this landslide was affected by our company's drilling activity. We must state that our drilling activity is entirely legal (according to Joja Company Amendment L61091), and protecting the local environment has always been our priority consideration! We deeply apologise for the inconvenience this accident brought. We sincerely express thanks for our customers' support and sponsorship! Morris, Joja Customer Satisfaction Department Representative. Joja Clears the Landslide

lewisStatue.chinese: @，^^今后，如果你能不把我的私人物品放在城里让所有人都看到，我会非常感激！^^我很不高兴！^^拿上这笔钱，不要向任何人提起我的“项目”。%item money 750 751 %%[#]刘易斯的抱怨信
lewisStatue.english: @, from now on, if you could not put my private belongings in town for everyone to see, I'd be very grateful! I'm very unhappy! Take this money, and don't mention my "project" to anyone. Lewis's Complaint Letter

linusTrashCleanup.chinese: @：^^你好。谢谢你帮忙清理山谷。^水看起来清澈多了。谢谢你，而且我想大家都会感谢你的。^为了表达“感谢”，我想教你种植纤维的方法。希望能帮到你。^^——莱纳斯%item craftingRecipe Fiber_Seeds %%[#]莱纳斯的感谢
linusTrashCleanup.english: @: Hello. Thank you for helping clean up the valley. The water looks much clearer. Thank you, and I think everyone will thank you. To express my "thanks", I want to teach you the way to grow fiber. I hope it helps you. Linus. Linus's Thanks

marnieAutoGrabber.chinese: @：^我的存货中新添了一件东西……叫做“自动采集器”。^^这件东西可以给奶牛和山羊挤奶、给绵羊剪羊毛、拾取鸡蛋和鸭毛……一切全自动！^^堪称是“奢侈品”，所以我开价 25000 金。^^——玛妮[#]自动采集器通知
marnieAutoGrabber.english: @: A new item has been added to my stock... called the "Auto-Grabber". This thing can milk cows and goats, shear sheep, and pick up eggs and duck feathers... all fully automatic! It can be called a "luxury item", so my asking price is 25000 gold. Marnie. Auto-Grabber Notice

mom1.chinese: 亲爱的@：^宝贝，你最近过的怎么样？你走了我真是朝思夜想。我希望农场上的生活是你期望的那样。^爱你的妈妈。^附：我把你最喜欢的饼干寄给你了。 %item id (O)223 1 %%[#]妈妈的信
mom1.english: Dear @: Sweetie, how have you been lately? Since you left I've really been thinking of you day and night. I hope life on the farm is what you hoped for. Love, Mom. P.S.: I've mailed you your favorite cookies. Mom's Letter

mom2.chinese: 亲爱的@：^很久没收到你的来信了。家里还是和回来的时候一样。我非常想你。^爱你的妈妈。 ^我收拾到一个装着一些钱的信封，那是你爷爷留下来给你的。 %item money 500 501 %%[#]妈妈的信 #2
mom2.english: Dear @: I haven't received a letter from you in a long time. Home is still the same as when you came back. I miss you very much. Love, Mom. I tidied up and found an envelope with some money in it, which your grandpa left for you. Mom's Letter #2

mom3.chinese: 亲爱的@：^我在报纸上看到关于你的报道了！乡村生活看起来很合你胃口呢！我真的为你感到自豪。好好照顾你自己，我的小甜心。爱你的妈妈。[#]妈妈的信 #3
mom3.english: Dear @: I saw a report about you in the newspaper! Country life seems to really suit your taste! I'm truly proud of you. Take good care of yourself, my little sweetheart. Love, Mom. Mom's Letter #3

mom4.chinese: 亲爱的@：^最近过的怎么样啊？你一定在农场那边赚了很多钱吧！就算变成百万富翁也别忘记你的老妈哦！^爱你的妈妈。 ^附：好好享用蛋糕吧！%item id (O)221 1 %%[#]妈妈的信 #4
mom4.english: Dear @: How have you been lately? You must be making lots of money over on the farm! Even if you become a millionaire, don't forget your old mom! Love, Mom. P.S.: Enjoy the cake! Mom's Letter #4

newsstory.english: Hello, @. We are very pleased to inform you that we will feature your farm in next week's "Vitality" column of the Stardew Valley Tribune! Congratulations! Your remarkable progress has impressed us. Stardew Valley Tribune. News Story

pamNewChannel.chinese: 孩子，你好：^^感谢你的“果汁”。它的确有一种……“独特”的风味^^顺便问一下，你有没有看过 736 频道？是一个季节性捕捞节目，你可能感兴趣。^^多多保重。^——潘姆[#]潘姆的提示
pamNewChannel.english: Kid, hello: Thanks for the "juice". It really does have a... "unique" flavor. By the way, have you watched channel 736? It's a seasonal fishing show you might be interested in. Take good care. Pam. Pam's Tip

passedOut2.chinese: @：^你真幸运，我昨晚找到你了！你都没有意识了，而且有人在翻你的口袋。我不知道他们拿走了你多少钱……我接近你的时候他们迅速跑走了。要多加小心啊！^^——莱纳斯[#]莱纳斯的笔记
passedOut2.english: @: You're really lucky I found you last night! You were unconscious, and someone was going through your pockets. I don't know how much of your money they took... when I approached they quickly ran away. Be more careful! — Linus. Linus's note

passedOut4.english: @: I found you lying face-down in the mud while cleaning at three in the morning. Next time you should go home as early as possible! — Marlon. Marlon's note

passedOutIsland_Leo.english: @: Hello. Last night I found you asleep in a dark place. That place isn't very safe, so the bird friends airlifted you to bed. Afterwards please be more careful about safety. — Leo. P.S.: Willy helped me write the letter.

pennySpa.chinese: 晚上到澡堂来见我 ^——潘妮[#]潘妮的笔记
pennySpa.english: Come see me at the bathhouse in the evening. — Penny. Penny's note

quest10.english: @: I've heard you've been lending a helping hand to the people of the town lately! Everyone is grateful to you! So I want to award you this month's "Best Neighbor" prize (and you'll get a little cash encouragement). Keep up the effort! — Mayor. Best Neighbor

quest100.chinese: @：^我很高兴宣布你当选了"年度最佳邻居"！奖金有整整 10,000金哦！衷心地祝贺你！镇上的乡亲们都折服于你的高尚行为！ ^——镇长%item money 10000 10001 %%[#]年度最佳邻居
quest100.english: @: I'm very happy to announce that you've been elected "Neighbor of the Year"! The prize money is a full 10,000 gold! Heartfelt congratulations! The townsfolk are all won over by your noble conduct! — Mayor. Neighbor of the Year

quest35.chinese: 亲爱的@：^你搬来镇上之后，一直都很乐于助人……大家都一直向我夸赞你！请收下这份谢礼。^——镇长%item money 2500 2501 %%[#]刘易斯的谢礼
quest35.english: Dear @: Since you moved to town, you've always been very glad to help others... everyone keeps praising you to me! Please accept this gift of thanks. — Mayor. Lewis's gift of thanks

robinKitchenLetter.english: Dear farmer @: When we first met I laughed at your grandpa's old wooden cabin; I now want to apologize to you. It's actually a really nice house! However, maybe one day you'll need to expand out more space. Then I can help. If you can bring me some raw materials and pay a certain fee, I can help you expand your house. I first plan to help you add a kitchen. With a kitchen, you can tinker there with your newly learned recipes! In short, I hope you treat Stardew Valley as your own hometown! Stardew Valley's carpenter, Robin. Robin's services

robinResource.chinese: @：^^你好！恭喜你完成了我的小挑战。你太棒了！^^我附上了一种新型箱子的设计图，就当作额外的奖励。希望你喜欢！^^——罗宾^^^^附：既然你已经有这么多资源了，要不要来试试做些建筑工程？%item craftingRecipe Stone_Chest %%[#]罗宾的资源活动
robinResource.english: @: Hello! Congratulations on completing my little challenge. You're amazing! I've attached the blueprint for a new type of chest, as an extra reward. Hope you like it! — Robin. robinWell.chinese: 我是罗宾！^我了解到你的农场周围有很多散落的碎石。^如果碎石有富余的话，你或许可以考虑让我给你建口井。^井可以建在农场里的任何地方，这样你给喷壶打水就更方便了。^^等你准备好了，带上 75 个石头和 1,000 金来我店里就行。^——罗宾[#]建一口井
robinWell.english: I'm Robin! I've learned there's a lot of scattered rubble around your farm. If you have extra rubble, you might consider letting me build you a well. A well can be built anywhere on the farm, so filling your watering can becomes more convenient. When you're ready, bring 75 stones and 1,000 gold to my shop. — Robin. Build a well

samMessage.chinese: @：^天黑后在我家门前等我 ^——山姆[#]山姆的笔记
samMessage.english: @: After dark wait for me in front of my house. — Sam. Sam's note

skullCave.english: I saw you previously entered the Skull Cavern. Well done. Young one, I have a bigger challenge to give you. Only when you reach at least floor 25 will the task count as complete. If you can complete the task, I'll give you a mountain of $. Your friend, Mr. Qi. Mr. Qi's challenge

spring_11_1.chinese: 寻物启事：^我把我的爱斧丢了！有谁捡到的话请即刻归还。没有它我非常不方便！任何找到它的人都能得到 250 金的奖励。^——罗宾%item quest 100 %%[#]罗宾弄丢了斧子
spring_11_1.english: Lost item notice: I've lost my beloved axe! Whoever picked it up, please return it at once. Without it I'm very inconvenienced! Anyone who finds it can get a 250-gold reward. — Robin. Robin lost her axe

spring_12.chinese: 亲爱的@：^明天我们会在广场欢庆复活节。^^如果你想和我们一起庆祝的话， 请在上午 9 点到下午 2 点之间到位。^一年一度的彩蛋大寻宝不容错过！^——镇长刘易斯[#]欢庆复活节通知
spring_12.english: Dear @: Tomorrow we will celebrate the Egg Festival in the square. If you want to celebrate together with us, please be there between 9 in the morning and 2 in the afternoon. The once-a-year great egg hunt is not to be missed! — Mayor Lewis. Egg Festival celebration notice

spring_15_1.chinese: 你好呀，亲爱的……^^我了解到你刚刚开始种菜，所以我想给你一个小小的提示。^^大多数作物只能生长一季。等夏天到了的时候，你在春天种的所有作物就都会枯萎。所以你要提前计划好！^^——艾芙琳奶奶[#]艾芙琳的提示
spring_15_1.english: Hello there, dear... I've learned you've just started growing crops, so I want to give you a little tip. Most crops can only grow for one season. When summer arrives, all the crops you planted in spring will wither. So you should plan ahead! — Granny Evelyn. Evelyn's tip

spring_15_2.english: Dear @: I want to give my husband a special gift. He especially likes leeks; could you give me some? — Granny Evelyn. Evelyn's surprise

spring_23.english: Dear @: Tomorrow is the Flower Dance! You can invite a dance partner and dance together with us. We'll hold the dance in the clearing behind the forest west of town. stardewHeroMine.english: Secret message: If you can go down to the bottom of the mine once more, you'll find a secret waiting for you to discover. But be careful, the mine is getting more and more dangerous now. Secret message

summer_10.english: Dear @: Tomorrow we'll gather on the beach to celebrate the annual Pelican Town Luau. The climax of this feast lies in sharing the potluck. Remember to contribute something tasty! summer_14_1.english: Hello kid, my throat is about to dry out completely. I really crave drinking a little pale ale. Do you have pale ale? Ordinary old beer won't do. It must be pale ale! — Pam. Pam's request

summer_28.english: Dear @: Tonight around 10 o'clock, an extremely rare but gorgeous event will take place. The moonlight jellies will pass by Pelican Town on their winter journey migrating south! winter_13_2.english: I have another challenge to test you: catch a lingcod! This thing isn't easy to get, but I know you can do it. — Willy. Willy's challenge #2

winter_14.english: Starting tomorrow, a traveling caravan will stop in Pelican Town to take part in the once-a-year Night Market. Night Market notice

winter_17_1.english: @: Sorry to bother you again, but this time I need you to help. I want to try what happens when my new hammer strikes different metals. Could you smelt an iron bar for me? Sorry for the trouble. — Clint. Clint's request

winter_24.english: Dear @: Tomorrow is the Feast of the Winter Star! Have you carefully prepared a gift for your "secret friend" (name)? The feast is held in the town square, starting at nine. Be there! — Mayor Lewis. Feast of the Winter Star reminder

winter_26_1.chinese: 亲爱的@：^我想要炖一锅鱼！我知道这个季节不好找……突然这样拜托你有点强人所难。但是你能帮我抓到一条回来吗？^——格斯%item quest 114 %%[#]格斯需要一种鱼
winter_26_1.english: Dear @: I want to stew a pot of fish! I know it's hard to find this season... asking you suddenly like this is a bit of an imposition. But could you catch one and bring it back for me? — Gus. Gus needs a kind of fish

winter_2_1.chinese: 嘿，帮我个忙吧：^    帮我抓只鱿鱼。^你可以晚上去大海里面找找。不过他们只在冬天出现。^——威利%item quest 109 %%[#]威利的挑战
winter_2_1.english: Hey, do me a favor: catch me a squid. You can go look in the sea at night. But they only appear in winter. — Willy. Willy's challenge

winter_5_2.chinese: @：^我在制作一支蕴藏有惊人力量的法杖。^但是,我现在需要一个铱锭！^我愿意出 5 倍的市价买它。快点帮我搞到。^——法师 M·拉斯莫迪斯 %item quest 123 %%[#]法师需要稀有物品
winter_5_2.english: @: I'm making a staff that holds astonishing power. However, I now need an iridium bar! I'm willing to pay 5 times the market price for it. Hurry and get it for me. — Wizard M. Rasmodius. The wizard needs a rare item

winter_6_1.chinese: 我有个特殊的请求。你可以不跟别人说嘛？^帮我把紫水晶交给艾米丽。这是她最喜爱的宝石。记得跟她说是我送她的。^——克林特 %item quest 110 %%[#]克林特特殊请求
winter_6_1.english: I have a special request. Can you not tell anyone else? Help me give the amethyst to Emily. It's her favorite gem. Remember to tell her it's from me. — Clint. Clint's special request

winter_7.chinese: 亲爱的@：^明天我们会在玛妮家前集合，庆祝冰雪节。^^这是我们欢庆冬天的日子……我们会堆雪人、做冰雕，还会有钓鱼比赛呢！^如果你感兴趣，早上 9 点到下午 2 点左右来和我们一起庆祝吧。^——镇长刘易斯[#]冰雪节通知
winter_7.english: Dear @: Tomorrow we'll gather in front of Marnie's house to celebrate the Festival of Ice. This is our day to celebrate winter... we'll build snowmen, make ice sculptures, and there'll even be a fishing contest! If you're interested, come celebrate with us from about 9 in the morning to 2 in the afternoon. — Mayor Lewis. Festival of Ice notice

wizardJunimoNote.chinese: 我的信息源告诉我，你一直在旧社区活动中心附近溜达。^何不来拜访我一趟？^我住在森林湖西边的石塔里。关于你那……“老鼠肆虐”的问题，我也许有一些线索。^——法师 M·拉斯莫迪斯 %item quest 1 true %%[#]法师的召集
wizardJunimoNote.english: My sources tell me you've been wandering around the old community center. Why not come visit me once? I live in the stone tower west of the forest lake. About your... "rat infestation" problem, I may have some clues. — Wizard M. Rasmodius. The wizard's summons
